queries: AI data center debt defaults restructuring October 2026

sources_considered.why: Readable report distinguishes repricing from payment performance in a specified data-center debt sample.
Searched for the underlying research, but did not obtain a readable primary article documenting the reported sample.
Readable Reuters reporting supplies context on credit-market stress, without establishing defaults.
Search result was dated after the evaluation cutoff and described a prediction question rather than a primary default record.

evidence_items.locator: Section No reported defaults in the analyzed pool
evidence_items.explanation: The report describes current loans in a sample of 19 data-center CMBS transactions despite wider spreads. This sample is not the full AI project-debt population, and current payments cannot refute an undated forecast.
Reuters reports rising concern about credit risk. Such market signals do not establish realized project defaults or an inevitable sector-wide collapse.

unresolved_gaps: No qualifying sector-wide collapse was established by the records located through the cutoff.
No comprehensive AI project-debt default and repayment dataset was obtained.
The claimed dependence on unsustainable customer payments has not been measured across the relevant population.
The underlying Trepp study was not obtained; its findings are reported secondhand.
